page.overview:
What is Alamut?

It was established in 6000 BCE by Haqim himself.

According to legend the Alamut is a mountain fortress whose exact location is a closely guarded secret. The head of the Assamite clan is referred to as the Old Man of the Mountain as he controls Alamut.

Reportedly a Nosferatu spy discovered the location of Alamut sometime during the Anarch Revolt. This discovery was part of the reason the Assamites chose to surrender and submit to the Tremere curse, rather than allow outsiders to attack and invade their home.

At some point early on in the Gehenna Crusade, before the Sabbat forces dispersed from the Middle East and continued their war worldwide, the Black Hand descended upon Alamut with their full, newly-concentrated force. The fortress and the entire region surrounding it has been scoured of all life and twisted with the eldritch sorcery of the Black Hand. Nighttime is lengthened around Alamut, such that a single night can stretch across up to forty days without end, and non-Sabbat Kindred are mentally forbidden from approaching.
